profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure | Typescript | Node
profile.summary:
Typescript backend software engineer building platforms for startups.

Email: contact@wilbertom.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Stepping into HOMEE has been an opportunity to blend innovation with leadership in transforming the AI-driven claims automation space. I’ve taken charge of an engineering team to design, refine, and advance an intelligent platform that automates home insurance repair workflows. My transition from backend and AI development to product and frontend leadership has allowed me to align user experience, scalability, and speed in every release cycle.

Key Accomplishments:

► Streamlined product delivery timelines by guiding the transition from backend focus to integrated product and frontend leadership, strengthening collaboration and accelerating cross-team efficiency.
► Trimmed AWS ELB infrastructure expenses by 50% by consolidating backend services, optimizing cloud utilization while retaining performance.
► Fortified legacy PHP environments by designing a secure Node.js / Typescript API proxy, reinforcing system integrity under rigorous compliance schedules.
► Automated provisioning processes by deploying Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with AWS CDK and Ansible to heighten reliability and expedite new product deployments.

Technology Stack: Typescript, CDK, NodeJS, React
positions.insights: Skills: Ansible · DevOps · TypeScript · Git · Node.js · Communication · Problem Solving · Pair Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At WithMe. I spearheaded full-cycle product development under Agile practices to align engineering velocity with organizational vision. My efforts were centered on creating dependable, automated infrastructure and translating conceptual ideas into thriving digital solutions that enhanced convenience for multifamily communities nationwide.

Key Accomplishments:

► Launched the PrintWithMe platform as the first engineer on the project, evolving an initial prototype into a production-ready ecosystem through years of iterative scaling.
► Devised the SipWithMe initiative by refactoring legacy frameworks, building a functional MVP within three months, and driving the creation of a spin-off company through client-led innovation.
► Maintained high-performing backend systems using Python, Flask, and MySQL, ensuring system durability and real-time data integrity across enterprise applications.
► Amplified asynchronous task execution by refining Celery and RabbitMQ configurations to increase background processing throughput and workflow reliability.
► Strengthened AWS infrastructure, including EC2, S3, and ECS components, by embedding granular access controls and reinforcing security posture to mitigate operational risks.
► Designed an intuitive, interactive user interface in React and JavaScript to foster improved engagement and usability for digital end users.

Technology Stack: Python, Flask, CDK, React
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · MySQL · Amazon S3 · RabbitMQ · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon ECS · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Git · Redis · Software Testing · Test-Driven Development · Python (Programming Language) · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Communication · Flask · Amazon VPC · Amazon EC2 · Problem Solving · SQL · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Here, I focused on modernizing financial technology infrastructure to drive performance and global reliability. I embraced test-driven and behavior-driven development principles to produce dependable code while supporting the modernization of distributed payment systems operating at international scale.

Key Accomplishments:

► Revitalized a legacy Ruby on Rails monolith by re-architecting core components, boosting maintainability, and laying the groundwork for sustainable scalability.
► Accelerated system throughput by integrating custom database sharding protocols to improve load distribution and enable seamless transaction processing.
► Directed Kafka-based data streaming workflows between PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch to increase data accuracy and streamline analytical processing.
► Constructed a fault-tolerant search infrastructure to sustain Uber’s massive payment operations, strengthening responsiveness and system dependability.
► Expanded Elasticsearch cluster efficiency within the search division, elevating performance to handle millions of daily records with consistent indexing precision.

Technology Stack: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Puppet, Elasticsearch
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · Amazon S3 · Git · Apache Kafka · Software Testing · Test-Driven Development · PostgreSQL · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Communication · Amazon VPC · Amazon EC2 · Problem Solving · Ruby · Ruby on Rails
